description: The root document's own static tool providers are computed from the effective document, after a profile's per-effect provider override already applied, on both engines: the document literally names 'shell' on 't', but the profile overrides 't' to 'json', so the generated 'child' effect's own use of 'json' is allowed -- without the profile, it would be refused the same way c772-reflector-tool-outside-ceiling-refused is.
